terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms are the agreement between you and Flexete ("Flexete", "we", "us") for using the Flexete app, its website pages and its services (together, the "Service"). Please read them. By creating an account or using the Service, you agree to them.
summary: You must be at least 13 to use Flexete, and 16 in some countries. If you are under 18, a parent or guardian must agree first.
You own what you post. You let us show it on Flexete so the Service can work.
Play fair: no fake accounts, no bought votes, likes or followers.
Follow our Community Guidelines. We may remove content or accounts that break them.
You can delete your account at any time. It is gone for good after 30 days.

sections.title: Who can use Flexete
body: You must be at least 13 years old to create an account. Where the law of your country sets a higher age, that age applies: 16 in Australia, Brazil, Indonesia and Malaysia.

If you are under 18, you can have an account only once your parent or legal guardian has agreed. We email them a link. They read what Flexete is and what it keeps about you, and say yes or no. Until they say yes, no account is made. If they say no, or do not answer within 7 days, what you entered is deleted.

A parent or guardian who agreed can change their mind at any time. The email confirming their answer has a link that closes the account and deletes everything in it, and they can also write to support@flexete.com.
You must give your real date of birth and an email address you use. We use your date of birth only to check your age, and we never show it or your email to anyone.
You cannot use Flexete if you have been banned from it before, or if the law where you live does not allow it.

sections.title: Your account
body: One account per person per email address. Your username is public, and you can change it once every 30 days. When you change it, your old one becomes free for anyone to take.

You can sign in with your username or email and a password, or with Google or Apple. Keep your password to yourself, use a strong one that you do not use anywhere else, and turn on two-step verification in Settings.

You are responsible for what happens on your account. If you think someone else has got into it, change your password straight away (this signs out every other phone) and tell us at support@flexete.com.
If you forget your password, you can reset it with a code we email to the address on your account.

sections.title: Battles, votes and leagues
body: Flexete is built around battles. Anyone can post a challenge, and others answer it with their own video. Viewers vote for the one they think is better.
Wins, losses and draws move your rating points, which place you in a league. The rules for points, leagues and who you can battle are in the Help Center, and we may adjust them to keep battles fair.
A video that has nothing to do with its challenge can be reported. If our check or enough viewers agree, its owner loses rating points.
Rating points, leagues and votes have no money value. They cannot be bought, sold, traded or exchanged for anything.

sections.title: Play fair
body: Do not try to win by anything other than your videos. In particular, do not:
• make fake or extra accounts, or use someone else's;
• buy, sell, swap or ask for votes, likes, views, shares or followers;
• use bots, scripts or automated tools on Flexete;
• report videos falsely to make someone lose points.
Votes and engagement that look bought or automated do not count, and accounts that do this lose rating points or are suspended.

sections.title: Your content
body: You keep ownership of everything you post: videos, photos, captions, comments and messages.

When you post, you give Flexete a worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free licence to host, store, copy, show and share that content, and to make versions of it that play well on different phones and connections. We use this licence only to run, improve and promote the Service. It ends when you delete the content, except where someone has already shared it, where we must keep it by law, or for copies that take a short time to clear from backups.
Public content can be seen by anyone, inside the app and on Flexete's web pages for shared profiles and videos. A private account's videos are shown only to its followers.
You must have the rights to everything you post. Do not post other people's work, music or images unless you are allowed to.

sections.title: Music in the app
body: Songs in Flexete's music library come from artists who let anyone use them for free, under licences such as Creative Commons. When a licence asks for the artist to be credited, Flexete adds the credit to your post. Do not remove it.

sections.title: Rules for content and behaviour
body: Everything on Flexete must follow our Community Guidelines, which are part of these terms. In short: no illegal content, no harassment or hate, nothing sexual involving anyone, no dangerous challenges, and respect for other people's privacy and rights.
We may remove content, limit features, or suspend or end accounts that break these terms or the Guidelines, or that put people at risk. Where we can, we tell you why.

sections.title: Using the Service properly
body: Do not interfere with how Flexete works. That means no hacking, no getting around limits or security, no collecting other people's data, no copying the Service, and no overloading it.
We limit how often some things can be done (signing in, asking for codes, changing a username) to keep accounts safe.

sections.title: Deleting your account
body: You can delete your account at any time in Settings. It is hidden from everyone straight away and signed out on every phone. Battles you are in at that moment end with no result.
For 30 days, signing in again lets you keep it, with everything back. After 30 days it is deleted for good: your profile, posts, battles, comments, likes, votes and followers.
Without the app, write to support@flexete.com from the email on your account and ask us to delete it.
We may suspend or end an account that seriously or repeatedly breaks these terms, or when the law requires it.

sections.title: Changes to Flexete and to these terms
body: We keep improving Flexete, so features may change, and some may be removed.
We may update these terms. If a change matters, we will tell you in the app before it takes effect. If you keep using Flexete after that, the new terms apply.

sections.title: Disclaimers
body: We work hard to keep Flexete running well, but it is provided "as is". We cannot promise it will always be available, free of mistakes, or that content on it is accurate. Content is the responsibility of the person who posted it, not of Flexete.

sections.title: Limits on our responsibility
body: As far as the law allows, Flexete is not responsible for indirect losses, lost data or lost profits that come from using the Service, or from content or behaviour of other people on it.
Nothing in these terms takes away rights you have by law that cannot be taken away by an agreement.

sections.title: Complaints
body: If you have a complaint about something on Flexete, about your account, or about a decision we made, write to our Grievance Officer at grievance@flexete.com.

We confirm every complaint within 24 hours and resolve it within 15 days. Content that shows someone's private parts, shows them in a sexual act, or pretends to be them (including edited or made-up pictures of them) is dealt with within 24 hours of a complaint from them or someone acting for them.
In India, if you are not happy with our decision, you can appeal to the Grievance Appellate Committee within 30 days, at gac.gov.in.

sections.title: The law that applies, and where you live
body: Flexete is run from India, and these terms are governed by the laws of India.

If you use Flexete as a consumer in another country, you keep every protection the law of your own country gives you and that an agreement cannot take away, and you may bring a claim in the courts of your own country where that law says you can.

European Union, United Kingdom and Switzerland: nothing in these terms limits our responsibility for death or injury caused by our carelessness, for fraud, or for anything else the law does not let us limit. People in the European Union can also use the European Commission's online dispute resolution service.
Australia: nothing in these terms takes away the guarantees the Australian Consumer Law gives you.
United States: if a part of these terms cannot be enforced in your state, the rest still applies.
What our Privacy Policy says for each country is part of how we keep these terms.

sections.title: Contact
body: Questions about these terms: support@flexete.com.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what information Flexete collects when you use the app and its website pages, why, who it is shared with, and the choices you have. We collect only what the Service needs.
summary: We never sell your information, and we do not show ads.
Your email and date of birth are private. Nobody else sees them.
We use what you watch to pick videos for you. You can clear your watch history any time.
Passwords and reset codes are stored scrambled, never as typed.
If you are under 18, a parent or guardian must agree before you have an account, and can close it at any time.
Delete your account and everything in it is gone after 30 days.

sections.title: Information you give us
body: • Account details: your username, your name if you add one, your email address, your date of birth and your password. Your password is stored scrambled, so not even we can read it.
• Profile: your photo, bio and other details you choose to add.
• Content: videos and photos you post, captions, tags, challenge answers, comments, likes, votes and saves.
• Messages and calls: the messages you send, and the fact that a call happened, so a missed call can be shown. Calls themselves are not recorded.
• Reports and feedback: what you tell us when you report a video or a problem.
• Interests: the kinds of videos you pick when you join.
• Google or Apple: if you sign in with one of them, the name and email address they share with us, and the id they give your account. We never see your Google or Apple password.

• If you are under 18: your parent's or guardian's email address, so we can ask them. When they answer, we keep a record that they agreed: their name, whether they are your parent or your guardian, the year they were born, and when and from which internet address and country they answered.

sections.title: Information collected as you use Flexete
body: • Activity: which videos you watch and for how long, what you tap, like, share and vote for, and who you follow and block.
• Device and connection: what kind of video your phone can play smoothly, the app version, and your IP address.

• Your country: worked out from your internet connection, or failing that from the region your phone is set to. Only the country, never where in it. We use it to apply the rules of your country, such as the age for joining, and to show you more videos made in your country. A video you post is marked with the country you posted it from.
• Notifications: a token from your phone that lets us send you notifications.
• Crash reports: when the app crashes or something fails, a report of what went wrong, with your phone's model and system version, so we can fix it.
• Camera, microphone and photos: used only when you record, call, or pick something to post. We receive only what you choose to post or send.
We do not collect your phone number, your contacts or your precise location.

sections.title: How we use it
body: • To run Flexete: your account, profile, posts, battles, votes, leagues, messages and calls.
• To pick videos for you: your For You feed is chosen from what you and people like you watch and enjoy.
• To keep Flexete safe and fair: checking reports, spotting fake votes and spam, limiting sign-in attempts, and protecting accounts.
• To follow the law where you are: checking that you are old enough to join, and asking a parent or guardian when the law says one must agree.

• To talk to you: notifications you have switched on, and emails about your account, such as a password reset code. If you are under 18, we also email your parent or guardian to ask for their permission and to confirm their answer.
• To fix and improve the app: crash reports and usage numbers show us what breaks and what works.

sections.title: What other people can see
body: Your username, name, photo and bio are public. So are your videos and battles, unless your account is private: then only your followers see them.
Public profiles and videos can also be opened from shared links on Flexete's web pages.
Your email address, date of birth, password, watch history and the accounts you have blocked are never shown to anyone.
If your activity status is on, people you chat with can see when you are online. You can turn it off in Settings → Privacy.

sections.title: Who we share it with
body: We never sell your information and do not share it for advertising.
We use a few trusted companies to run the Service. They act on our instructions and only get what they need:
• Render, which hosts our servers and database;
• Cloudflare, which stores and delivers videos and photos;
• Google Firebase, to deliver notifications to your phone;
• Sentry, to receive crash reports;
• an email service, to send password reset codes and the emails to a parent or guardian;
• Google or Apple, only if you choose to sign in with them.
We may also share information when the law requires it, to protect someone's safety, or as part of a sale or merger of Flexete, in which case this policy would continue to protect it.

sections.title: How long we keep it
body: • Detailed watch activity: about 30 days. After that it is folded into a summary of what you like, and the detail is deleted.
• Your content: until you delete it, or delete your account.
• Password reset codes: 15 minutes, or until used.
• A sign-up waiting for a parent or guardian: 7 days at most. If they say no, 1 day. Then it is deleted. You can also cancel it yourself, which deletes it at once.
• The record that a parent or guardian agreed: as long as the account exists. It is deleted with the account.
• Your account: until you delete it. It is then hidden at once and deleted for good, with everything in it, after 30 days.
Some records may be kept longer where the law requires it, or to deal with abuse.

sections.title: Your choices and rights
body: In the app you can: edit your profile; make your account private; choose who can message and call you; hide your activity status; block people; delete posts; clear your watch history; choose your notifications; change your password; turn on two-step verification; and delete your account.

Depending on where you live, you may also have the right to see a copy of your information, correct it, have it deleted, take it with you, or object to how we use it. Write to privacy@flexete.com and we will answer. You can also complain to your local data protection authority.

sections.title: Keeping it safe
body: Connections to Flexete are encrypted. Passwords and reset codes are stored scrambled, and changing your password signs out every other phone. Two-step verification adds a code from an authenticator app to signing in. We limit how often anyone can try to sign in or ask for a code. No system is perfect, but we work to protect your information.

sections.title: Children and young people
body: Flexete is not for children under 13, or under 16 in Australia, Brazil, Indonesia and Malaysia, and we do not knowingly collect their information. If we learn that someone under that age has an account, we delete it. If you think a child is using Flexete, tell us at privacy@flexete.com.

Anyone under 18 can have an account only after a parent or legal guardian has agreed. We ask them by email, with a link to a page that explains what Flexete is and what it keeps. This checks that an adult with their own email address agreed. It does not check identity documents.

A parent or guardian can, at any time: close the young person's account and delete everything in it, with the link in the email we sent them; or write to privacy@flexete.com to see what we keep about the young person, or to have it corrected.

We do not show advertisements to anyone, and we never sell or share a young person's information for advertising. What a young person watches is used only to choose videos for them and to keep Flexete safe.

sections.title: Information across borders
body: Flexete is run from India. The companies that help run it store and process information in other countries, including the United States. When they do, we make sure it stays protected as this policy describes, using the agreements the law asks for.

sections.title: Where you live
body: The rights in "Your choices and rights" are for everyone, wherever you live. To use any of them, write to privacy@flexete.com. We answer within 30 days, and sooner where your law says so. We never treat you worse for using a right. Some countries add more:

India. Under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, you can ask what we hold about you and how it is used, have it corrected, completed or erased, take back a consent you gave, and name another person to use these rights for you if you die or cannot act. Complaints go first to our Grievance Officer at grievance@flexete.com; if you are not satisfied, you can then complain to the Data Protection Board of India. For anyone under 18 we ask a parent or guardian first, as described above.

European Economic Area, United Kingdom and Switzerland. We use your information on these grounds: to provide the Service you signed up for (your account, posts, battles and messages); our legitimate interests in keeping Flexete safe, fixing it, and choosing videos for you; your consent, or a parent's or guardian's, where we ask for it, such as notifications; and the law, where it requires something of us. You can ask to see your information, correct it, erase it, limit how it is used, take it with you, object to a use, and take back a consent. You can complain to the data protection authority where you live (in the United Kingdom, the Information Commissioner's Office). When information leaves your region, it is protected by standard contractual clauses or another safeguard the law accepts.

United States. We do not sell your personal information, and we do not share it for advertising based on what you do on other apps or sites. Depending on your state, you can ask to know what we hold, to get a copy, to correct it, and to delete it, and you may appeal our answer by writing to privacy@flexete.com. If you are under 18, you can remove anything you posted by deleting it in the app. Flexete is not for children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect their information.

Brazil. Under the Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados, you can ask us to confirm that we hold your information, to see it, to correct it, to make it anonymous, block or delete it where it is not needed, to take it with you, to tell you who we share it with, and to take back a consent. You can complain to the Autoridade Nacional de Proteção de Dados.
Australia. You can ask to see and correct the information we hold about you, and you can complain to the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner.
Other countries. If the law where you live gives you rights that are not listed here, you have them with us too.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
body: If we change this policy in a way that matters, we will tell you in the app before the change takes effect.

sections.title: Contact
body: Privacy questions and requests: privacy@flexete.com.
Complaints about how we handle your information: our Grievance Officer at grievance@flexete.com. We confirm every complaint within 24 hours and resolve it within 15 days.

guidelines.title: Community Guidelines
guidelines.intro: Flexete is a place to show what you can do and to take on challenges, safely and fairly. These guidelines apply to everyone and everything on Flexete: videos, photos, captions, comments, messages and profiles.
summary: Be creative, be competitive, be kind.
Never post a challenge that could hurt someone.
No harassment, hate, or sexual content.
Win with your videos, not with fake votes.
Report what breaks these rules. We review it.

sections.title: Safe challenges
body: Challenges are the heart of Flexete, so they must never put anyone at risk. Do not post or encourage challenges that could cause injury, such as stunts that risk serious harm, misuse of medicine or substances, holding your breath, fire, or dangerous driving.
If a challenge looks dangerous, do not answer it. Report it.

sections.title: Respect for people
body: No bullying or harassment: no threats, insults, humiliation, or piling on someone.
No hate: nothing that attacks people for their race, ethnicity, nationality, religion, caste, sexual orientation, sex, gender, gender identity, disability or serious illness.
Disagree and compete as hard as you like, but never make it personal.

sections.title: Safety and wellbeing
body: No violent extremism, threats of violence, or content that praises violence.
No content that encourages suicide, self-harm or eating disorders. If you or someone you know is struggling, please reach out to a local helpline or emergency service.
No graphic violence or gore.

sections.title: Young people
body: Accounts are for people 13 and over, and 16 and over in some countries. Anyone under 18 needs a parent or guardian to agree first. Anything that sexualises, endangers or exploits young people is never allowed, is removed, and is reported to the authorities.

sections.title: Nudity and sexual content
body: No nudity, sexual activity or sexually explicit content, and no content offering or asking for sexual services.

sections.title: Fair play and honesty
body: Win with your videos. No fake accounts, bought or swapped votes, likes or followers, bots, or false reports.
Answer a challenge with a video that matches it. A video that has nothing to do with its challenge costs its owner rating points.
Do not pretend to be another person or organisation, and do not spread false information that could cause harm.
No spam or scams.

sections.title: Privacy
body: Do not share other people's private information, such as their address, phone number, documents or private messages, and do not film people in private places without their consent.

sections.title: Illegal and regulated things
body: No content that sells or promotes illegal drugs, weapons, or other illegal goods and services, or that shows crimes being committed.

sections.title: Other people's work
body: Post only what you made, or have permission to use. Use the free songs in Flexete's music library rather than music you do not have the rights to.

sections.title: What happens when rules are broken
body: Depending on how serious it is, we may remove the content, take rating points, limit features, or suspend or ban the account. Serious harm can lead to a ban the first time.
If you think we got it wrong, write to support@flexete.com and we will look again.

sections.title: Reporting
body: To report a video, tap More (⋯) on it and choose Report. To report an account, open their profile, tap More (⋯) and choose Report. To report a comment, press and hold it. Choose why, add a few words if you like, and send.
A person reads every report. What breaks these guidelines is removed, and the account may be suspended. Nobody is told who reported it.
On a battle, More (⋯) also has "Doesn't match the challenge", for a video that has nothing to do with what the challenge asks.
To stop someone reaching you, block them from their profile. If someone is in immediate danger, contact your local emergency services.
For anything else, use Settings → Report a problem, or write to our Grievance Officer at grievance@flexete.com.
